_about: The keyword registry (phase 1 of the design plan, 2026-11-12). One list of keywords that every screen, the Units page and the docs are meant to read from. Nothing in the game reads this file yet: it changes no rules and no screens. Checked by tools/tests/keywords.js, which also writes docs/KEYWORDS-TAGGING.md. Not the same file as src/keywords.json (that one feeds the Miro board).

rules._kit: Every keyword ships as a kit: an icon, a role colour (from its role), an effect seen on bodies in the fight (fx), a sound, a three-second demo on the island, and a line of at most maxWords words. null = not made yet. icon = the inside of an svg on a 24 by 24 grid, drawn in currentColor so the role colour comes from the page.
rules._cap: Raised from 17 to 18 on 2026-11-12: Tank left (the Guard role says it), Taunt and Teleport joined.

roles._about: The role is the glyph's colour. A plate (plate: a path on the 24 by 24 grid) can also stand behind the glyph, but sparingly: the bare glyph is the default (owner, 2026-11-12; where plates are used is not decided). glyph = how big the icon sits on the plate and at what height. A plate with no glyph is the role alone: a Guard with no keyword is a tank. Colours are placeholders.

conjure.name: Conjure
conjure.line: Makes new things on the board.

keywords._about: wave 1 = the launch set a new player meets. wave 2 = in today's game or the Verbs doc, waiting. Only wave 1 needs a line and a kit. A role can be a list (Teleport is Control or Support, by what the ability does): the unit or skill that uses it says which. alts = other candidate drawings for a keyword that the owner has not chosen between yet.

units._about: What each unit does in today's game: verb (a keyword), or role alone when its job is the role itself (a Guard with no keyword is a tank). also = other keywords built in. planned = the job the Roster doc plans, where it differs. Tagged from the unit's stats and traits in src/default-roster.json, not from the docs.

Sniper.note: Snipe folds into Shoot with long range.

Earth Wizard.planned: Hurl: a boulder that stops at the first unit it hits.

Slimeshots.note: Has 3 m splash today; the Verbs doc lists it as Shoot.

Spiders.note: No poison built in today; Poisonous fangs is a skill.

Flame Wizard.note: A flame cone with no burn built in today; Spitfire is a skill.

Obelisk.note: Grow is wave 2, so the Obelisk has no wave 1 verb. On hold in the Roster doc as well.

skillTypes._about: Every skill type in the roster, sorted three ways. keywords = it gives the unit these keywords. stat = a plain numbers change that needs no keyword (it shows as pips). unfit = a mechanic no keyword covers yet, with a note on what it would need.

shrink.note: Cuts enemy range; Blind is the nearest word in the Verbs doc.

flow.note: Attack speed and range that build up while standing still.

turret.unfit: Hits several targets at once. Three skill types do this (turret, split, multibeam): a candidate for one keyword.

split.unfit: Hits several targets at once (see turret).

multibeam.unfit: Hits several targets at once (see turret).

dodge.unfit: Avoids hits by chance. Chance is hard to show; could fold into Shield.

spread.unfit: Changes the squad's formation. A deploy rule, not a fight keyword.

freeMove.unfit: Changes a deploy rule (moves cost nothing).

lone.unfit: Changes who it targets. Targeting has no keyword yet.

leafblade.unfit: Turns the unit into another unit. In the new system this is a path, not a skill.

berserk.unfit: Immune to Slow and Push, plus a small enemy debuff. Would need an Immune rule.

armor._about: Armor weight: a different kind of symbol from the keywords, in steel grey, never on a role plate: a flat-topped shield that fills up (none, a third, two thirds, full, full with battlements). Chosen by the owner, 2026-11-12. Which units get which weight is not decided.
